components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; padding: 14px 26px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 6px); background: var(--forest, #244536); color: var(--white, #FFFFFF); border: 1px solid var(--forest, #244536); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Public Sans', sans-serif); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), border-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--forest-dark, #183328); border-color: var(--forest-dark, #183328); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--forest, #244536); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-form-group { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; max-width: 400px; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Public Sans', sans-serif); } .ds-form-label { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink-secondary, #22352C); } .ds-form-input { width: 100%; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Public Sans', sans-serif); font-size: 0.96875rem; color: var(--ink, #14241D); background: var(--white, #FFFFFF); border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #CBD8D1); border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 6px); padding: 12px 14px; transition: border-color 0.18s ease, box-shadow 0.18s ease; } .ds-form-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-light, #687B72); } .ds-form-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--forest, #244536); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(36, 69, 54, 0.12); }

narrative.overview:
Ekonomika presents itself with the calm, institutional credibility of a modern Swedish corporate accounting and advisory firm—benchmarked against Aspia, Ludvig & Co, and Grant Thornton Sverige. Built for Swedish business owners across trades and professions (builders, hairdressers, medical clinicians, lawyers, and founders) as well as private declaration clients, the visual system replaces boxed brutalist grids, monospace badges, and terracotta template chrome with generous white space, deep executive forest-green authority, and straightforward service clarity.

The system alternates a crisp white primary canvas (--white) with soft Nordic sage-mist section bands (--surface-alt) and full-bleed executive forest-dark bands (--forest-dark) for the header, hero, digital workflow section, and footer. A unified corporate sans-serif family (Public Sans) handles every typographic role from 700-weight display headlines down to 400-weight Swedish prose and 600-weight form labels, keeping the reading experience calm, direct, and unhurried.
keyCharacteristics: Alternating Executive Bands: Full-bleed deep executive forest (--forest-dark) hero and workflow bands alternate with crisp white (--white) and soft Nordic sage-mist (--surface-alt) editorial sections.

Single-Family Corporate Sans: Public Sans across all display, headline, title, body, and label roles (tabular-nums enabled globally on body) with zero decorative kickers, eyebrows, or monospace badge housings.

Restrained Hairline Separation: Subtle 1px solid hairline dividers (--border on light surfaces, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) to 0.14 on dark forest surfaces) separate section bands, editorial service rows, and card headers without boxing content into rigid cells.

Measured Corner Geometry: Restrained 6px radii (--radius-sm) for buttons, form inputs, and social icon buttons paired with 10px radii (--radius-md) for editorial photography frames, service pillar cards, and the contact form card.
Natural Stockholm Advisory Photography: Real and bespoke natural-light Nordic office photography (aspect-ratio: 4 / 3 and 16 / 10) grounded by soft ambient elevation shadows.

rules.name: The Alternating Band Rule
rules.body: Page rhythm comes from full-bleed horizontal surface transitions between Executive Forest Dark (#183328), Crisp Advisory White (#FFFFFF), and Nordic Sage-Mist (#F4F7F5). Never place heavy outer box borders around entire page sections.

rules.name: The Sage-On-Forest Contrast Rule
rules.body: Luminous Sage Accent (#D9E7C8) with #183328 text is reserved exclusively for primary triggers and highlights sitting on #183328 dark forest bands (.nav-cta, .btn-light, .workflow-step h3, active nav underline). On light #FFFFFF or #F4F7F5 surfaces, primary actions always use solid Corporate Pine Forest (#244536) with #FFFFFF text.

rules.name: The Direct Heading Rule
rules.body: Every h1, h2, and h3 opens directly at its natural typographic scale without uppercase kickers, category eyebrows, or boxed numeral prefixes.

rules.name: The Single-Voice Sans Rule
rules.body: All headings, body copy, navigation links, buttons, and form controls use Public Sans (--font-sans). Never introduce decorative display serifs or monospace badge fonts.

rules.name: The Restrained Lift Rule
rules.body: Interactive buttons and social links never cast heavy drop shadows; on :hover and :focus-visible, they respond with a subtle -1px to -2px vertical lift (transform: translateY(-1px)) and crisp color transitions over 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1).

dos: Do alternate section backgrounds cleanly between #183328 (--forest-dark), #FFFFFF (--white), and #F4F7F5 (--surface-alt), using 1px solid #E2EAE5 (--border) only for subtle horizontal section or row separation.
Do set all typography in Public Sans (--font-sans) with 700 weight for h1/h2 headings (-0.02em to -0.025em tracking) and 400–500 weight for Swedish body prose (54ch–65ch).
Do use --radius-sm (6px) on buttons and form inputs and --radius-md (10px) on cards and photography frames, paired with --shadow-card or --shadow-elevated.
Do use #D9E7C8 (--sage-accent) with #183328 text for primary CTAs and active indicators on dark #183328 bands, and solid #244536 (--forest) with #FFFFFF text for primary CTAs on light surfaces.
Do use round-capped (stroke-linecap="round", stroke-linejoin="round") SVG checkmarks and directional arrows across lists, trust strips, and text links.
donts: Don't introduce heavy 1.5px brutalist outer grids, 0px sharp-cornered plates, or exposed cell borders around content sections.
Don't use terracotta, brass, or orange accent colors (#B86438), display serifs (Bricolage Grotesque), or boxed monospace numeral badges (Azeret Mono).
Don't place uppercase kickers, category eyebrows, or pill tags above h1, h2, or h3 headings.
Don't fabricate customer testimonials, client logo walls, or numeric pricing tiers.
